roadmap.title: Main playthrough
roadmap.description: Play through the hotel investigation once, solving every puzzle, collecting the kissing spots and coins, and making a save at each choice point.

roadmap.title: Alternate choices from saves
roadmap.description: Reload the basement and choice saves to take the opposite option on each mutually exclusive choice.

roadmap.title: Detective endings
roadmap.description: From the save after power is restored, open the safe in room 509, remove the listed evidence, and give the listed interrogation answers.

roadmap.title: Evidence-tampering ending
roadmap.description: From the same save, remove the listed evidence while leaving doors and lockers open and stepping in the blood, then give the listed interrogation answers.

roadmap.title: Maid endings
roadmap.description: Replay from the first basement save without opening the safe in room 509 to finish the three maid endings.

achievements.description: You did not clean the puddle by the restrooms, leading to Andrew slipping and hurting himself.
achievements.summary: Leave the puddle by the restrooms uncleaned so Andrew slips and gets hurt.

guide.context: This is exclusive with The Puddle Patrol and has no effect on the ending. Save before the puddle to get both.

steps.text: After the discovery in the chapter Off to Room 505, walk to the elevator without cleaning the puddle.

achievements.description: You cleaned the puddle by the restrooms and prevented Andrew from getting hurt.
achievements.summary: Clean the puddle by the restrooms so Andrew does not slip.

guide.context: This is exclusive with Slippin' Andrew and has no effect on the ending. Save before the puddle to get both.

steps.text: After the discovery in the chapter Off to Room 505, clean the puddle on the way to the elevator.

achievements.description: You chose Andrew as your acolyte.
achievements.summary: Choose Andrew as your acolyte.

guide.context: This is exclusive with The Beauty of the Clarington and has no effect on the ending. Save before choosing to get both.

steps.text: In room 505, after the discovery in the chapter A Disturbing Discovery, pick Andrew when the phone call asks who helps you.

achievements.description: You chose Beth as your acolyte.
achievements.summary: Choose Beth as your acolyte.

guide.context: This is exclusive with The Bookworm and has no effect on the ending. Save before choosing to get both.

steps.text: In room 505, after the discovery in the chapter A Disturbing Discovery, pick Beth when the phone call asks who helps you.

achievements.description: You opened the safe in room 505.
achievements.summary: Open the safe in room 505.

guide.context: The code comes from the discharge date, address and army division found in the room.

steps.text: Take the key lying on the TV set and unlock the suitcase by the bed.
Read the suitcase letters, the handwriting on the back of the bedside photo and the note about moving to room 507.
Enter 34-99-57 on the safe and turn the handle.

achievements.description: You solved the torn note puzzle in room 509.
achievements.summary: Solve the torn note puzzle in room 509.

guide.context: Clean each bin to find its shred.

steps.text: Collect the three Torn shreds of paper: the bathroom bin, the bin right of the sofa, and the bedroom corner bin.
Place the straight edges at the top with the largest piece top left, then rotate each piece until the clue reads correctly.

achievements.description: You solved the secret code puzzle in room 509.
achievements.summary: Solve the secret code puzzle in room 509.

steps.text: Solve the torn note puzzle first.
Check the bedroom note beside the briefcase, the diary numbers at bottom right, the Texas Trust Bank papers and the bedside snippet.
In room 505, read the Beaver Lake Skate Rental note and the Harry's Diner receipt on Mr Spade's wall to get more symbols.
Return to the note and decode the hidden message.

achievements.description: You erased the lipstick message, so no one was fired by Bernard.
achievements.summary: Erase the lipstick message so that nobody is fired by Bernard.

guide.context: This is exclusive with So Long, Linda and Wendy Gets the Boot, and it changes the maid endings. Save at your first basement visit to get all three.

steps.text: Wipe off the lipstick writing in the basement.
Throw away the note on the office door.

achievements.description: You protected Wendy, which caused Linda to get fired by Bernard.
achievements.summary: Protect Wendy so that Linda is fired by Bernard.

guide.context: This is exclusive with Status Quo and Wendy Gets the Boot. It is required for Moving Up the Ladder and blocks both Eugene achievements.

steps.text: Do not touch the lipstick writing or the office-door note.
Open Wendy's locker and throw away the evidence inside.
Once the room 509 code is cracked, overhear Linda and Bernard talking inside room 508.

achievements.description: You did not prevent Wendy from getting fired by Bernard.
achievements.summary: Let Bernard fire Wendy.

guide.context: This is exclusive with Status Quo and So Long, Linda. It is required for Employee of the Month.

steps.text: Leave the lipstick message, the note on the office door and the evidence in Wendy's locker untouched.
Once the room 509 code is cracked, overhear Linda and Bernard talking inside room 508.

achievements.description: You messed up while talking to Bernard, forcing your acolyte to step up and take the fall for you.
achievements.summary: Slip up while talking to Bernard so your acolyte takes the blame.

guide.context: This is exclusive with The Bernard Whisperer. It changes the detective endings. Save before the elevator to get both.

steps.text: In the elevator, tell Bernard you are on break.
After leaving Bernard's office, lie to him again.

achievements.description: You managed to talk your way out of Bernard's questions without involving your acolyte.
achievements.summary: Answer Bernard's questions without your acolyte taking the blame.

guide.context: This is exclusive with Shouldn't Have Said That. The detective endings need this option. Save before the elevator to get both.

steps.text: In the elevator, tell Bernard you are on break.
When you step out of the office, answer him honestly.

achievements.description: You protected Eugene, so he did not get fired by Bernard.
achievements.summary: Stop Bernard from firing Eugene.

guide.context: Linda must not be fired. This is exclusive with Eugene Gets the Boot and has no effect on the ending. Save before the office to get both.

steps.text: Inside the office, mop the water, bin Eugene's note and shut the window.
Later, when you return to the basement, eavesdrop on Bernard in the office.

achievements.description: You did not prevent Eugene from getting fired by Bernard.
achievements.summary: Let Bernard fire Eugene.

guide.context: Linda must not be fired. This is exclusive with Live to Fix Another Day and has no effect on the ending. Save before the office to get both.

steps.text: In Bernard's office, leave the puddle, Eugene's note and the window as they are.
Later, when you return to the basement, eavesdrop on Bernard in the office.

achievements.description: You opened the vent and decoded the second secret message.
achievements.summary: Open the vent and decode the second secret message.

guide.context: The first vent note is solved in the maintenance room on the fifth floor.

steps.text: Pick up the screwdriver beside the window in the manager's office.
Use the screwdriver on the vent in the fifth-floor hallway and take the note.
Solve the note, then phone your acolyte.

achievements.description: You put money in your tip jar so you can go to Paris... one day.
achievements.summary: Put coins in your tip jar.

steps.text: Collect the loose coins lying in room 507.
Go back down to the basement and drop them in your tip jar.

achievements.description: You snooped on your acolyte and used your newfound knowledge in dialogue. Real smooth.
achievements.summary: Search your acolyte's locker, then use what you learned in dialogue.

guide.context: For Beth pick "Like taming alligators?" and then "I loved it." For Andrew pick "Ever read banned books?" and then "How do you get those books?"

steps.text: Before taking the item in the basement, open your acolyte's locker and inspect every item.
After the key double is made, pick the dialogue options for your acolyte.

achievements.description: You made a key double with your acolyte.
achievements.summary: Make a key double with your acolyte.

steps.text: Return the Master Key to the basement locker room.
Pick up the plaster near the fifth-floor maintenance closet.
Take the candle from the drawer opposite the laundry room sink.
Read the note by the right shelf to start the key double.

achievements.description: You solved Anne's riddle and opened the case in room 509.
achievements.summary: Solve Anne's riddle and open the case in room 509.

guide.context: Forcing the lock breaks it. Save before opening the box.

steps.text: Turn the key double slowly in the wooden box in room 507.
Read the riddle note and the code-word letter, then close the box.
In room 509, open the suitcase on the bed with the code GRIS.

achievements.description: You restored the power on the 5th floor.
achievements.summary: Restore the power on the fifth floor.

steps.text: Open the fuse box in the fifth-floor janitor's closet and restore the power.

achievements.description: You opened the safe in room 509 and made some interesting discoveries...
achievements.summary: Unlock the room 509 safe and examine the newspaper in it.

steps.text: Read the small note in the laundry room tray.
Find the second note in the fuse box in the fifth-floor janitor's closet.
Enter the code 23-42-16 on the safe, then zoom in on the newspaper.

achievements.description: You and your acolyte kissed.
achievements.summary: Kiss your acolyte.

steps.text: Pick the flirting option in every dialogue with your acolyte.
At the end, choose to kiss them.

achievements.description: Your actions leave the police at an impasse and nobody goes to prison.
achievements.summary: End the case with nobody sent to prison.

guide.context: Use a save made after restoring power. This Bed You Made unlocks with it.

steps.text: Unlock the room 509 safe and examine its newspaper.
Throw away the same items as for The Real Culprit?, and also the newspaper in the safe.
Leave some lockers, doors, safes and drawers open, keep the keys, and step in the blood by the ice machine.

During the interrogation, answer in this order: Mr. Cruz's body was blocking the doors; I used an ice pick; No, nothing; It was just an assumption; I don't know anything about her; I don't know anything about him.

achievements.description: Your actions send the real culprit to prison.
achievements.summary: Have the real culprit put in prison.

guide.context: Use a save made after restoring power. Avoid stepping in the blood by the ice machine, and choose the truthful options with Bernard. Method Acting, This Is California and Bye Bye Bernard unlock with it.

steps.text: Unlock the room 509 safe and examine its newspaper.

Throw away everything in 505 and 507, the case letters and secret notes in 509, the diary by the ice machine, Mr Cruz's body evidence by the elevator, and the reception letter, railway tickets and brochure.

Close every locker. During the interrogation, answer in this order: Mr. Cruz's body was blocking the doors; I used an ice pick; No, nothing; Mr. Cruz received some death threats; Mr. Cruz told me; I don't know anything about him; I don't know anything about her.

achievements.description: Your actions keep Anne and Marcela out of prison.
achievements.summary: Keep Anne and Marcela out of prison.

guide.context: Unlocks at the same ending as The Real Culprit?.

steps.text: Earn The Real Culprit? with the same save, evidence list and interrogation choices.

achievements.description: Your actions keep Paul out of prison.
achievements.summary: Keep Paul out of prison.

guide.context: Unlocks at the same ending as The Real Culprit?.

steps.text: Earn The Real Culprit? with the same save, evidence list and interrogation choices.

achievements.description: Bernard has no one to blame and gives the hotel back.
achievements.summary: Leave Bernard with no one to blame so he gives the hotel back to his brother.

guide.context: Unlocks at the same ending as The Real Culprit?.

steps.text: Earn The Real Culprit? with the same save, evidence list and interrogation choices.

achievements.description: You tamper with evidence, get caught and go to prison.
achievements.summary: Be caught tampering with evidence and sent to prison.

guide.context: Unlocks at the same ending as Dead End and Gone.

steps.text: Earn Dead End and Gone with the same save.

achievements.description: You get Linda fired and are a good maid.
achievements.summary: Get Linda fired while cleaning every room, keeping guest items and leaving the room 509 safe shut.

guide.context: Start from the first basement save. Someone from Paul or the Anne and Marcela pair has to be jailed.

steps.text: Get Linda fired as in So Long, Linda.
Clean every room fully: beds, pillows, towels and hotel cups.
Keep all guest items and leave the room 509 safe shut.
Answer Bernard with "If it comes with a raise, yes."

achievements.description: You get Wendy fired and are a good maid.
achievements.summary: Get Wendy fired while cleaning every room, keeping guest items and leaving the room 509 safe shut.

guide.context: Start from the first basement save. Someone from Paul or the Anne and Marcela pair has to be jailed.

steps.text: Get Wendy fired as in Wendy Gets the Boot.
Clean every room fully: beds, pillows, towels and hotel cups.
Keep all guest items and leave the room 509 safe shut.
Answer Bernard with "If it comes with a reward, yes."

achievements.description: You stand up to Bernard and quit.
achievements.summary: Quit in front of Bernard, ending with no money.

guide.context: Use the first basement save.

steps.text: Do not clean the rooms and do not throw away guest items.
Leave the room 509 safe shut so that Paul and/or Anne and Marcela end up in prison.
Choose the line "You can't fire me because I quit." when Bernard questions you

achievements.description: You completed the game.
achievements.summary: Finish the game.

steps.text: Play through to the epilogue.

achievements.description: You found all three of Wendy and Jacques' kissing spots.
achievements.summary: Spot every one of the three places where Wendy and Jacques kissed.

guide.context: Check each spot as you pass through the area.

steps.text: Find the kissing spot behind the door in a janitor's closet.
Find the spot on the basement wall next to the breakroom door.
Look at the sign on the maintenance room wall for the third spot.
